description:
Start here when the user says "add Checkbox", "make my subscriptions compliant", or the project is not connected to Checkbox yet. Checkbox checks a subscription business against automatic-renewal laws (federal law, 27 states, DC and New York City).

Connected through the Checkbox connector (OAuth): the human already approved in the browser; there is NO key to ask for, paste or save. Call it with site_url (and what else you know): it registers the site and runs the first checks in the same call.
Pass everything you already know from the codebase: site_url, checkout_url, terms/privacy/refund/cancellation URLs, billing_platform, plans, project.layout_file. Checkbox fetches and checks the Terms itself.

Without OAuth or a key: it returns a link for the HUMAN to open and click Approve (free, no card). Show it in one line, then call again with the returned device_code (waits ~50 s; again while pending). The stdio server then saves the key to the git-ignored .env.local; the remote one returns it once: save it there, never commit it or ask for a pasted key.

After this: follow next_action (usually verify the domain and install the snippet, then get_setup_status with verify=true), then get_compliance_plan.

account_url.description: Account page where subscribers manage / cancel (null clears a URL).

agent.description: Which AI agent is doing this, shown to the human on the approval page, e.g. "Claude Code".

cancellation_url.description: Separate cancellation policy page, if not in the Terms. Not where people cancel (account_url).

device_code.description: From an earlier setup_checkbox call: poll that browser approval instead of starting a new one.

live.description: Also request live-mode keys (live mode activates after domain verification). Default false: test mode only.

merchant_name.description: The brand subscribers know (names the seller in generated disclosures), e.g. from the <title> or package.json Default: the host name, which the plan asks you to replace.

plans.description: Plans and prices in the code, e.g. [{"name":"Pro","amount":1900,"interval":"month","trial_days":14}]; a promo adds intro_percent_off and intro_periods. They decide which laws apply.

project.description: Facts about the codebase that help Checkbox point tasks at exact files.

checkout_code.description: Where Stripe Checkout Sessions / payment links are created, e.g. [{"file":"app/api/checkout/route.ts","line":12,"kind":"stripe_checkout_session"}].

kind.description: Required: stripe_checkout_session, stripe_payment_link, stripe_pricing_table, stripe_elements, subscribe_button, shopify_checkout…

framework.description: nextjs-app, nextjs-pages, remix, sveltekit, nuxt, astro, express, html, shopify-theme…

layout_file.description: Root layout / template where the snippet belongs, e.g. "app/layout.tsx".

pay_buttons.description: Where the subscribe / pay buttons are rendered.

site_url.description: Public URL of the site (production or a preview), e.g. "https://acme.example".

terms_url.description: Terms of service URL. Checkbox fetches and checks it.

name: setup_checkbox
title: Set up Checkbox for this project
